worldcombat.skill.avalanche.summary: Stand your ground and tip the snow in front into one wide, low mass that slides along the real ground in the aimed direction: it follows gentle slopes down, is stopped by solid walls and clear steps, and spills apart at cliffs. Each enemy the snow front touches is hit once, and the blow is doubled while you carry the battered grudge.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.use.0: Press a whole rank of enemies with one broad sheet of snow down a slope or flat ground
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.use.1: Crash out with a doubled slide after taking a round of hits
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.use.2: Pin pursuers and shove them away against a wall or below a step
The avalanche deals about %1$s physical damage. While Avalanche is equipped, every real attack from an enemy that hits you gains a stack of battered (up to 5 stacks, lasting 10 seconds and refreshed and stacked by further hits); with any stacks the blow is doubled.

Stand still and raise a snow mass half-width %3$s blocks, then slide it along the ground up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick in the aimed direction: it follows gentle slopes down, is pinned by solid walls and steps and spills apart at cliffs. Each non-ally the snow front touches takes damage once - the centre band takes full damage and the two edges about 70%% - and is shoved forward about %4$s blocks (70%% at the edges). The last stretch it crossed leaves frost on replaceable natural ground for %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.deepdrift.on: Deep drift on: snow half-width ×1.25, knockback ×1.15 and the slide reaches about 12% farther to press the area; in exchange the hit is about ×0.90, the wind-up is 2 ticks longer and the cooldown is 8 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.deepdrift.of: Deep drift off: the hit is about ×1.06 and the slide finishes cleanly, putting all the weight into one blow.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.timing: Cast in the chosen direction with about %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s it spends %4$s PP to slide, then recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.growth.0: At level %1$s the avalanche power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.growth.1: At level %1$s the avalanche power rises to %2$s and the snow half-width grows to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.preference.d: On: snow half-width ×1.25, knockback ×1.15 and the slide reaches ×1.12 farther, pressing the area; but the hit is ×0.90, the wind-up is 2 ticks longer and the cooldown is 8 ticks longer. Off: the hit is ×1.06 and the slide finishes cleanly.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.preference.a: Only consider sliding at targets within this distance; raise it to close on more distant foes.
On: prioritise crashing out while you carry the battered grudge (exactly the doubled window); off: only prefer it when surrounded with a clear path ahead.
